item.title: Silfab Solar allowed to resume operations amid opposition
item.description: Silfab Solar in Fort Mill, SC was allowed to resume assembly operations by the EPA and South Carolina's Department of Environmental Services, but manufacturing is still on hold due to chemical leaks and the need for an engineer to evaluate the chemical systems.
